title: The Queen
summary: The lower Amazon, the wet season 2775. The flood comes to Lindqvist's island; in the pens the Mothers fight, and the strongest grows into a Queen.

sides.name: The Brood
sides.about: The creatures on Lindqvist's island: one Mother, her Sires and the young of the stock.

sides.name: The Fazenda
sides.about: Lindqvist, Pieter and the keepers, with the lures, two swivel guns and the big house.

sides.name: The Wild Mother
sides.about: A wild Brood Mother and her pack, carried onto the island by the flood.

sides.name: The East Pen
sides.about: Another of Lindqvist's breeding Mothers, fenced in the north-east pen, and the young round her.

objectives.text: THE FLOOD: bring the young out of the two flooded pens up to the big pen: {in_pen} of {young_n} there. They obey only inside a keeper's green ring, so move them along with the keepers.
objectives.phone: Young to the big pen: {in_pen} of {young_n}. Keep them in a keeper's green ring.

objectives.text: The water covers the paths in {clock:flood}.

THE MOTHERS FIGHT: kill the other two Mothers ({mothers_down} of 2 down). Your creatures obey only inside your Mother's ring: out of it, near another Mother, they go over to her. Take your Mother to the fight.
objectives.phone: Kill the other Mothers: {mothers_down} of 2. Fight inside your Mother's ring.

objectives.text: THE QUEEN: root your Mother in the big pen (ROOT on her card) and press GROW. She grows for a minute; lay eggs meanwhile.
THE FALL: lay BRUTES on the Queen's card (the Tyrant Sire rooted beside her) and break the palisade, then the big house.
THE FLOOD: walk your keepers up to the big pen: the animals follow only inside a lure's ring ({in_pen} of {young_n} there).

BURN THE PENS before the Queen grows: a keeper or Lindqvist stands 4 seconds in each of the big pen, the north pen and the east pen ({burned} of 3). Sleeping creatures wake 3 steps away: clear them with the guns first.
objectives.phone: Burn the pens: {burned} of 3. A man stands 4 s in each.

objectives.text: Then get Lindqvist to the canoes at the landing (Pieter too, with the stud book, if you can).
The strongest Mother grows into a Queen in {clock:queen}. The Mothers are too big for muskets.

deny.why: Not on the island: the flood has drowned the ground.
Not now: everything she has goes into growing. GROW her first.

k_open1.text: Three years after the commission the river rose higher than anyone on it could remember.

k_open2.text: Lindqvist still tells that night as a breeding season that went wrong.

l_open1.text: The wet season of 2775. The water came up into the cane, then into the low pens.

l_open2.text: I had two breeding Mothers on the island by then. I thought I was a rich man.

l_open_saved.text: The first from the clutch we carried out of the station. I named her Linnea, like her mother. The second bred from her.

l_open_burned.text: The first netted on the mountain. I named her Linnea, like the one at the station. The second bred from her.

k_open_f.text: Lindqvist says he burned the pens that night. Listen to how much he burned.

l_open_f.text: The water was in the cane. Something was calling from the north shore. I sent for the torches.

l_1.text: The low pens are under water. Pieter, the keepers. Bring the stock up to the big pen. All of it.

n_lesson.text: Your creatures obey only inside a keeper's green ring. Select them and move them with the keepers, a little at a time.

n_call.text: A deep sound comes over the water from the north-west shore. Every head in the pens turns toward it.

p_call.text: Doctor, the ones outside the rings are walking toward it.

n_loose.text: A creature out of every ring walks toward the sound. Bring a keeper's ring back over it.

p_in.text: They are all up in the big pen, Doctor. Wet, but all there.

p_late.text: The water is on the paths, Doctor. We cannot wait for the rest.

n_wild.text: The flood has carried a wild Mother onto the north-west shore, and a pack with her.

n_wild_rival.text: A big pack for a wild Mother. A pack off the Rio Negro, perhaps.

l_drop.text: Leave the lures. Everyone to the house. Shut the gate.

n_mring.text: The keepers are gone. Now your creatures follow only their own Mother: they obey inside her ring. Out of it, near another Mother, they go over to her.

n_uproot.text: Your Mother can fight. UPROOT her on her card and walk her to the fight; rooted, she only waits.

n_east.text: In the north-east pen the other bred Mother breaks her fence. The young round her go with her.

p_fight.text: They are fighting each other, Doctor. Mother against Mother.

l_fight.text: Write it down, Pieter. Every hour of it. Nobody has ever seen this.

n_lost.text: One of yours strayed out of your Mother's ring and has gone over to another Mother.

n_wild_down.text: The wild Mother is down. Her pack wanders, and turns toward the strongest call left.

n_east_down.text: The east pen's Mother is down. Her young wander, and turn toward the strongest call left.

n_joined.text: Loose creatures of the fallen Mothers come into your Mother's ring and stay.

n_part3.text: One Mother is left on the island. Root her in the big pen and press GROW on her card.

l_house.text: Close the shutters. Load the swivel guns. Pieter, bring the stud book down.

p_changing.text: Doctor, the big one in the middle is changing. She is getting bigger.

l_shoot.text: Keepers! To the big pen. Shoot her. Shoot her now, before it is done.

n_growing.text: She is growing. Lay eggs meanwhile, with the Sires rooted beside her.

l_show.text: Every animal on the island turned toward the big pen. I had no lure for that.

n_fall.text: Every bred creature on the island turns to the Queen. Lay BRUTES on her card and break the palisade, then the big house.

p_book.text: The book, Doctor! The lure book is upstairs!

n_canoe.text: A canoe goes down the river in the dark with two men in it.

n_canoe1.text: A canoe goes down the river in the dark with one man in it.

n_pieter_lost.text: Pieter did not reach the canoes.

n_house.text: The big house falls. The island belongs to the Queen.

n_mother_dead.text: Linnea is dead. Another will root in the big pen.

l_f1.text: Torches. We burn the pens before they settle it among themselves. Then the canoes.

p_f1.text: The guns first, Doctor. They are asleep in the straw, and they wake when you walk up to them.

n_f_burn.text: A pen burns: straw, fences, the troughs.

l_f_big.text: The big pen is burning. They will have to settle it somewhere else, and that takes time.

l_f_go.text: Enough. To the canoes, all of you.

p_f_warn.text: Doctor, the big one in the middle is changing. It is getting bigger.

l_f_won.text: Push off, Pieter. Do not look back.

l_f_lost.text: Too late. It is growing. Everything on the island is turning to it.

l_end1.text: I stood up in the canoe and looked back. The whole island was moving.

l_end_all.text: Every animal I had bred was on that bank. Not one came to the lure.

l_end_some.text: Half my stock was on that bank. The rest lay dead in the pens.

l_end_few.text: Few of mine were on that bank. The pens had killed most of them.

k_end1.text: He says the flood did it. He bred nothing. He kept animals that were made long ago to become exactly that.

k_end2.text: The Church told him what they were. He still says they evolved.

l_end_f.text: We burned three pens and went down the river at first light. I have the stud book. I burned the rest.

k_end_f.text: He told me he burned them. He did not burn enough.

n_guards.text: The keepers are Assembly men now, paid in sugar and silence.

n_no_pieter.text: Pieter is not on the island any more. Two keepers carry the lures on each side.

n_sire_all.text: The Tyrant Sire beside her is the young Sire of the plateau's cages, grown.

new_stage3.text: NEW: GROW TO THE THIRD STAGE. Rooted, the Mother grows once more: more eggs, faster laying, and the Brute's eggs. It takes a minute and she must stay rooted.

new_brute.text: NEW: THE BRUTE. Laid by the Mother at her third stage with the Tyrant Sire rooted beside her: a huge horned beast that batters down palisades and gates.

flood.caption: The island below Óbidos, the wet season 2775: the flood.

queen.caption: The Queen in the big pen.

canoes.caption: The canoes from the burning house.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King and his prisoner, the doctor.

text: The lower Amazon, the wet season 2775. You are the creatures on Lindqvist's island: one Brood Mother, her two Sires and the young of the stock.
First the flood: walk the young up to the big pen inside the keepers' rings. Then the other Mothers come: kill them, keeping your creatures inside your own Mother's ring.
Then root her in the big pen and GROW her into the Queen, and break the fazenda.
The lower Amazon, the wet season 2775. You are Lindqvist's people on the island: Lindqvist, Pieter, the keepers and two swivel guns.
The Mothers in the pens are fighting. Burn three pens before the strongest grows into a Queen, then get Lindqvist to the canoes.

brood.title: The Queen
brood.text: The fazenda fell in a night. Of the {bred_n} bred creatures on the island, {went} ended with the Queen.

text_if.text: Pieter did not reach the canoes.
The lure book was left in the house.

fazenda.title: The Canoes
fazenda.text: Lindqvist burned {burned} pens and went down the river.
